title: rust impl-block: struct field added on one side, field value + format changed on both
notes: Two hunks inside one `impl Config`. Target raises max_retries 3->5 and rewrites label() with brackets; replayed adds the timeout_ms field (struct + constructor) and extends label() with the timeout. The preferred resolution keeps the higher retry count (5), the new field, and combines both format-string changes. Keeping replayed's 3 is an acceptable alternative.
